title: POV: you're mid-fade and your phone won't stop buzzing
description:
every buzz is someone asking for a time. you can't answer with clippers in your hand, so you reply between cuts and hope you didn't mix anything up.

with MyHour you get your own booking page for your bio. clients pick a free time themselves, 24/7, no account needed, and they get a confirmation email with a calendar invite. no marketplace, no competitors next to you, and no commission on bookings, ever.

€9/month after a 14-day free trial, no card needed to start.
